verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a chat and workspace platform like Open WebUI, but the evidence pack never documents a native way to select and act on many items at once, such as bulk delete, archive, move or edit of chats, files or memories. The nearby evidence covers different capabilities: parallel sub-agents and worktree agents (task delegation), scheduled automations (recurring runs) and API keys or plugins (developer building blocks a user could use to script bulk actions). None of these is the bulk-operations capability itself, so none earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
